screen.auto-bridge.settings.title: Auto-bridge settings
tooltip.auto-bridge.bridge_mode: Which kind of bridging the build key starts. Each mode has its own stance, its own headings to build along and its own click pace.
tooltip.auto-bridge.smooth_camera: Moves the camera to its target the way a hand moves a mouse instead of instantly.
tooltip.auto-bridge.smooth_duration: Time in seconds for a wide camera turn; shorter turns take proportionally less. Only numbers from 0 to 5 are allowed.
tooltip.auto-bridge.imprecision: Adds an occasional human-like offset to camera alignment and block centering, makes the smooth camera speed up and slow down unevenly, and spaces out clicks unevenly. RANDOM chooses 12–25% for each action.
tooltip.auto-bridge.imprecision_chance: How often the selected imprecision is used when the mod needs precision.
